method: Macro v5 plus a fold-aligned binary alive/dead logistic head, averaged 50:50 into P(D), preserving conditional H/A odds and all temporal operations.

pose_s_feature_metadata.kit_labels: raw tracking teams; no possession GT

limitations: All feature and method selection reuses the same public 17 possessions.
Repartitioning is a sensitivity check, not independent validation.
Macro-F1 slightly decreases at 3 folds (-0.000297); it increases at 4/5/6 folds.
Spell-F1 is unchanged in all paired repartitions.
Away class F1 decreases at 5 folds; H and D improve.
No private, unseen-match or full-match accuracy is known.
Full-match statistics describe predictions, not evaluated full-match performance.
Rejected pose trials use the corrected held-out stitching protocol. A discarded scratch run had its fold-index variable overwritten; its refit scores are excluded.
Models, crops, features and output labels remain gitignored.
